title: The Flat Critical Branch Between Nariai and Bertotti-Robinson Geometries as a Solution of Cosmological Einstein-Maxwell Theory
summary: We analyze a class of product geometries of the form $\mathbb{R}^{1,1}\times Σ_2$ supported by electric, magnetic, or dyonic flux in the Einstein-Maxwell-$Λ$ theory. These spacetimes belong to a unified family of direct products $(dS_2,\mathbb{R}^{1,1},AdS_2)\times Σ_2$ distinguished solely by the sign of the Lorentzian curvature of the two-dimensional factor. We focus on the critical configuration for which the Lorentzian curvature vanishes.
